Class LessonsLearnedCollection

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedCollection
public class LessonsLearnedCollection extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedCollection

Description: A simple wrapper around a List of LessonsLearned objects. It is used to pass groups of lessons (for example, all lessons written by one author) between the database layer and the GUI.

    • removeLessonByTitle

      public boolean removeLessonByTitle(String title)
      Removes the first lesson whose title matches the given title, ignoring case. If several lessons share the same title, only the first match is removed.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the lesson to remove
      Returns:
      true if a lesson was found and removed, false if no lesson had a matching title

    • getLessons

      public List<LessonsLearned> getLessons()
      Returns the underlying list of lessons. The list is not copied, so changes to the returned list are reflected in this collection.
      Returns:
      the list of lessons in this collection

    • returnTitles

      public List<String> returnTitles()
      Builds a list containing the title of every lesson in this collection, in the same order as the lessons themselves.
      Returns:
      a new list of lesson titles (empty if the collection is empty)
